usage: agentware update [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--check] [--catalog]
                        [--self-heal] [--staleness-check] [--status-line]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --check               report current vs upstream + changelog, then STOP
                        (read-only; safe for a SessionStart updates-available
                        nudge)
  --catalog             also show which authored skill-catalog entries the
                        pending update would add/remove (read-only)
  --self-heal           reconcile a crashed prior apply (re-smoke ->
                        finalize/rollback/strand); used by the loop reverse-
                        guard on a stale updater lock
  --staleness-check     layer-2 on-use nudge: if the last signed-channel fetch
                        is >24h old, read-only fetch + WARN (never applies;
                        always exits 0)
  --status-line         read-only, no-network one-liner for SessionStart
                        (silent when up-to-date; surfaces a
                        stranded/unfinalized apply)
